shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side. A woman in a navy blazer at the pinboard-side window seat tells an anecdote, a man in an olive sweater is at the entrance-side window seat, and a woman in a mustard cardigan is at the pinboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the entrance end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and the pinboard-end seat in frame.

shots.content: The man in an olive sweater asks the woman in a navy blazer a question.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a navy blazer answers the man in an olive sweater.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the pinboard end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the entrance, with both window-side seats and the pinboard-end seat in frame.
